subject: Re: MetaPose kickoff — status + occlusion risk for the pilot
body:
Status:

- Reproduction: done 04-08 from the released metapose.tar data + checkpoints; Human3.6M and Ski-Pose PTZ numbers match the paper in our harness (PMPJPE within 1mm on H36M).
- Latency: Rosa's optimized path runs the full multi-view model in 31ms on a single A100 — comfortably real-time for the sports use case, and consistent with the minimal-latency-overhead claim.

Risk for the 06-08 pilot: the model's uncertainty handling for occluded joints is a strength on Ski-Pose, but the robotics rig is worse than anything in the papers — two of four cameras are frequently blocked by the robot arm itself, simultaneously. In our synthetic-occlusion stress test, PMPJPE degrades ~2.2x when two views drop together. Maren is adding a per-frame confidence gate so downstream consumers can filter; I'd rather ship honest confidence than smoothed garbage.

We're on track, but the pilot report will need an occlusion-regime section.

Linnea
